source_evidence: Make sure the hedge fund managers are qualified to manage your money and find out whether they have a disciplinary history within the securities industry.
answer: When researching a hedge fund manager, consider whether the manager is qualified to manage money and whether they have a disciplinary history in the securities industry. If the manager is an SEC-registered investment adviser, you can review the adviser’s Form ADV. The source says you can find a firm’s Form ADV using Investor.gov’s Check Out Your Investment Professional tool.
